reference.text: Now these three mates—Starbuck, Stubb, and Flask, were momentous men.

reference.text: They called him King-Post on board of the Pequod; because, in form, he could be well likened to the short, square timber known by that name in Arctic whalers; and which by the means of many radiating side timbers inserted into it, serves to brace the ship against the icy concussions of those battering seas.
